5e39e937e188e1ed35f2bbb4d9cf9dea6f07f854.scene_en: A lone ultramarathon runner on a circular forest trail at dawn, several translucent overlapping silhouettes suggesting many repeated laps and endurance through the night. Curving dynamic brushstrokes, no phone, no city buildings.

10e33e4addbb6b77627fea9c93c1b2bdb49d0033.scene_en: A quiet Moscow apartment sanctuary: sculptural pale stone and warm wooden surfaces, a soft sofa, a large window framing distant city rooftops. Geometric architectural planes, calm generous light and contemplative empty space.

095b6c31c553e38134a5277f1b06ee026e69be73.scene_en: An American elm tree with a broad vase-shaped crown, new green seedlings emerging beneath it. Delicate branching roots connect genetically diverse young trees, a visual metaphor for restoring disease-resistant elm populations. No city streets or buildings.

58464c0b913c8eb7e26f4a7c9a122e169065d2bf.scene_en: In a Central African village, a community spiritual elder and a healthcare worker meet with families under a large tree, an open circle and a bridge of warm light symbolizing trust during Ebola response. Abstract human figures, no portrait likeness, no hospital signs, no snow or European buildings.

69e87f49e218b714a71851b9aa8442ba557481c3.scene_en: A close-up still life of winter running shoes with deeply textured gripping soles, snow crystals and rain droplets, a winding icy trail receding into the background. Flowing decorative curves and botanical patterns. No brand marks or written labels.

622864a94513688d9a15f84f52eca43aed8ecc4a.scene_en: A bundle of blank envelopes and small colorful childlike drawings glowing warmly in the hands of an elderly man, with a distant classroom and a connecting ribbon of light. Metaphor for letters from schoolchildren sustaining a soldier and kindness remembered across generations. No writing on paper.

076df96c6dcc1a9d23622e45fd9eca5ec1259b7a.scene_en: A person sitting awake beside a bed holding a softly glowing phone, a dark window and a small bedside lamp, the blanket extending like a quiet river toward sleep. Metaphor for bedtime procrastination, boredom and the temptation to keep scrolling. No visible screen text, no forest.

32c35848803d0dc46fb768fdc14d2a1f3fa04d10.scene_en: Children absorbed in free imaginative play on a safe sunlit playroom floor, assembling wooden blocks, a cardboard arch and fabric tents while an adult quietly watches from the doorway. Loose warm brushstrokes, a visual metaphor for autonomy and creativity, no written letters.

visual_subjects.cc64317410c339d257222dad17ef92c9ffeb0722: A conceptual architectural view of an elevated tropical house on a steel frame among the treetops of Costa Rica, with an open living space, deep roof overhangs and cross-ventilation. Express the dialogue between structural geometry and jungle canopy, not a documentary reconstruction of the actual building.
visual_subjects.1cfc4479ba34a01f5e23f546e1580904b88952de: A visual metaphor for changing car-buying choices: a buyer considers three unbranded cars of different sizes in an elegant showroom, with flowing branching paths suggesting a shifting budget and hybrid technology. No prices, charts, lettering, brand badges or numerical claims.
visual_subjects.d4ebf54b24f9f48ada7f1448550af9389dc27768: A paper-collage metaphor for a changing automobile market: cut-out unbranded car silhouettes, layered blank purchase papers and intersecting routes suggest consumer choices and new technology. Keep the composition distinct from a showroom scene. No text, invented statistics or logos.
visual_subjects.801172b1e9617f50b8d25aadbe6519497ecc444f: An architectural interior where tall translucent, textured and mirrored glass doors divide connected rooms; overlapping light, shadows and pivoting or sliding planes reveal spatial depth. Treat this as an original design metaphor, not a reproduction or advertisement for a named product.
visual_subjects.0e4912af87b38e634627aa813939b742afe6371b: An original conceptual view of a modest hillside family house inspired by a renovated mid-century ranch: dark charred-wood exterior, mature trees, restrained natural materials and quiet light through the interior. No invented portrait, exact architectural reconstruction or signage.
visual_subjects.8c3c4f74d9c7d8e4815cea217cc2af9a95fabf85: A painted visual metaphor for consumerism inside a fictional video-game world: a game controller in the foreground, a stylized coastal city reflected in a shopping window, blank shopping bags and virtual tokens. Question the cycle of real and virtual spending; no game screenshots, logos, text or currency amounts.
visual_subjects.9db97cd64a34f2413c4dff221f1bfb4f520f3ffc: A film director's drawing table: an open sketchbook with original unlettered character studies, pencils and a ribbon of film leading into a distant imagined cinema scene. Evoke the passage from drawing to cinema and the creative work of Georgiy Daneliya, without copying his drawings or inventing his portrait.
visual_subjects.ea1b421bb34d9c3ecda13d468036d87f9bf5d769: A quiet space for reflective reading and yoga: an open book without legible print and a pencil beside a folded yoga mat, with organic lines linking the printed page to a contemplative human silhouette. No claims of medical benefits, mystical facts, logos or religious advertising.
visual_subjects.c8a053aafee7e5f84eb2c6f3de0860546e4b9d30: A sensitive metaphor for alcohol dependence within a marriage: a worried woman and her husband sit separated by a small table with one unlabelled bottle in a quiet home interior. A doorway suggests a difficult choice about safety and trust. No cheerful family scene, forest, drinking glamour or invented treatment claims.
visual_subjects.cd952cbb0c9ee1cdb5be6e7f25d04a4166302de1: A speculative industrial drawing of the boundary between mind and technology: the outline of a human head connects through fine structural lines to an abstract lattice and memory-like light patterns. Show an unresolved philosophical question, not a proven brain-upload procedure or a real medical device.
visual_subjects.65283963673c1bacd9e84c4def1dcb693711d676: A supermarket still life as a cut-paper collage: blank food packages, simple ingredient shapes, a magnifying glass and small traffic-light markers evoke careful reading of nutrition labels. No readable text, fabricated nutritional numbers, brand names or exaggerated health claims.

1cfc4479ba34a01f5e23f546e1580904b88952de.review: One reference, correct article subject and palette; advisory ornamental/texture limitations retained, not a claim of perfect artistic quality.
